params.message:
Each Claude login says who it is, how it is doing, and what it did today

/accounts reported whether a login file existed per slot, and no call said which
account made it. It now reads the slot's own account record (email, organisation;
never the token), gives one state in order (no login, refused, limited, working,
unproven) with a sentence, and counts today's calls per account from token_usage,
which records the account from now on. POST /accounts/probe makes one tiny Haiku call
on one account to turn unproven into an answer; it never writes the halt marker.
